Returns a collection of Observation Items.
See [Filtering on List Actions](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/filtering-on-list-actions) for information on using the filtering capabilities provided by this endpoint.

parameters.name: filters[assignee_company_id]
parameters.description: Array of Vendor IDs. Returns item(s) where the assignee is associated to the specified Vendor ID.

parameters.name: filters[checklist_list_id]
parameters.description: Array of Checklist List IDs. Return item(s) associated with the specified Checklist List IDs.

parameters.name: filters[created_by_id]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) created by the specified User IDs.

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[location_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified Location IDs.

parameters.name: filters[assignee_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) assigned to the specified User ID.

parameters.name: filters[checklist_item_id]
parameters.description: Return Observations(s) originating from the specified Checklist Item(s).

parameters.name: filters[custom_fields]
parameters.description: Return Observation Items whose custom field values match the supplied JSON object. The object is keyed by custom field definition ID. Matching uses JSONB containment, so only item(s) containing all of the supplied key/value pairs are returned.

schema.description: JSON object where each key is a custom field definition ID

parameters.name: filters[priority]
parameters.description:
Return only Observation Items at the given priorities. Values are
case-sensitive and match the `priority` field on the Observation.
Comma-separate values to match several priorities, e.g.
`filters[priority]=High,Urgent`.

parameters.name: filters[search]
parameters.description: Return item(s) matching the specified Search query.

parameters.name: filters[status]
parameters.description:
Return only Observation Items in the given lifecycle states. Statuses are
supplied as their integer codes:
```
  0: Initiated
  1: Ready For Review
  2: Not Accepted
  3: Closed
  4: Draft
```
Comma-separate values to match several states, e.g. `filters[status]=0,1`.
`4` (Draft) only matches Observations governed by a workflow that has not yet
been started.

parameters.name: filters[type_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified Observation Type ID.

parameters.name: filters[trade_ids]
parameters.description: Array of Trade IDs. Returns item(s) with the specified Trade IDs.

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.description: Unique identifier for the project.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Elements per page

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort item(s) by an attribute. The default sort is ascending. To sort in descending order, prepend the sort value with a hyphen character '-'. Default sort is number ascending.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Controls how much of each Observation is returned. `normal` (the default) returns the documented response body. `ids` returns a bare array of Observation IDs — by far the cheapest option when you only need to know which Observations match a filter. `compact` trims the payload to list-row essentials, `base` is smaller still, `web` and `full` add attachments, drawings, root-cause associations and distribution members, `permissions` populates the `permissions` object, and `safety_hub` returns a minimal set plus `overdue`.

post.description:
Creates an Observation Item on the specified Project. `observation[name]` and `observation[type_id]` are required; `number`, `personal` and `due_date` default from the Project's Observations configuration when omitted.

Assignees must be users the requesting user is permitted to assign — check `GET /rest/v1.0/observations/assignees` first, or the request is rejected with a `403`. Supply either `assignee_id` or `assignee_ids`, not both.

An Observation can be linked to an originating record by supplying exactly one of `checklist_item_id`, `coordination_issue_id`, `incident_action_id` or `bim_model_id`.

x-changelog.description:
The can_create_observation permission now supports granular permissions. A new can_create_observation_from_inspection
permission allows read-only users to create observations from inspection items when granted.

x-changelog.summary: Enable viewable document generation for attachments uploaded via upload_ids
x-changelog.description:
Fixed an issue where attachments uploaded via the `upload_ids` parameter could not be viewed
in the document viewer. When creating or updating observations with `upload_ids`, the backend
now automatically generates viewable documents and thumbnails for the uploaded files, ensuring
they can be properly displayed in the document viewer.
